# Lim Chee Kin
> AI Solutions Architect at Daxonet AI in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia. Enterprise AI agents, document extraction, RAG and voice AI, built in Python and TypeScript.

## About
Lim Chee Kin is an AI Solutions Architect at Daxonet AI, based in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia. He designs and ships enterprise AI: conversational agents, document extraction, human approvals, and integration with accounting and business platforms. His work spans retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), real-time voice systems, cloud operations and distributed teams. Before AI, he led enterprise Java teams and delivered banking and healthcare systems.

## Core Skills
- Languages and backend: Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, Java, SQL; FastAPI, Pydantic, Node.js, Bun, Spring Boot; REST APIs, webhooks and Server-Sent Events
- AI engineering: Claude Agent SDK, MCP, Google Gemini, LiteLLM, OpenRouter, ragbits, Docling; multimodal document extraction, agent tool permissions, hybrid retrieval, Ragas and LLM evaluation
- Data and storage: PostgreSQL/pgvector, SQLite, SurrealDB, MongoDB Atlas, MinIO
- Frontend: React, Next.js, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, React Native and Flutter
- Voice and enterprise integration: Pipecat, Gemini Live, Whisper, Kokoro; Teams Bot Framework, WhatsApp, Telegram, Google Workspace, AutoCount and Dynamod
- Security: OAuth 2.0 with PKCE, JWT validation, role-restricted agent tools, AES-256-GCM token encryption
- Infrastructure and quality: Docker/Compose, Kubernetes, Linux, AWS, GCP/GKE, GitHub Actions, pytest and Vitest, OpenTelemetry, Prometheus and Grafana

## Current Projects
At Daxonet AI:
- Claim Pilot: Expense claims from Teams and WhatsApp, read by AI, approved by humans, and posted as GL journals
- Trade Pilot: Purchase orders arrive on WhatsApp as photos, PDFs or Excel, and leave as quotations and sales orders
- WareBot: Conversational assistant for a Warehouse Management System; every write waits for an explicit confirmation
- Agentic AI Layer: Multi-channel agents that reach accounting and business systems through role-restricted MCP tools
- Smart HVAC Catalogue System: RAG backend matching air-conditioners to room type, size and usage

Open source:
- [Project Concord](https://github.com/limcheekin/project-concord): A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that lets modern AI agents query legacy database schemas, with permission controls
- [Talk To AI](https://github.com/limcheekin/talk-to-ai): A real-time voice AI application for low-latency (<300ms) interactions, supporting local and cloud STT, LLM, and TTS services
- [RAG.WTF](https://www.rag.wtf/): An open-source platform for private, personalized knowledge discovery and management using RAG systems
- [TelegramGPT](https://github.com/limcheekin/TelegramGPT): AI-powered Telegram bot for natural language conversations
- [open-text-embeddings](https://github.com/limcheekin/open-text-embeddings): Python library for open-source text embedding models

## Past Contributions
- [Fluwix](https://github.com/limcheekin/fluwix): Flutter showcase platform
- 10+ Grails Framework plugins for the developer community
